description.summary: You mimic Scarmiglione Z’s ability to feast upon the essence of your enemies with but a touch
description.value: You mimic Scarmiglione Z’s ability to feast upon the essence of your enemies with but a touch. As a standard action , make a melee touch attack; if successful, the enemy takes 8d6 points of shadow damage, and you are healed as much. The target must also make a Fortitude save, or be staggered for 1 round. If used on undead or creatures immune to shadow damage, it still functions, dealing non-elemental damage instead, and they must still roll a Fortitude save to negate the stagger effect. Learned From Scarmiglione Z and Ser Paulecrain.
